source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the ways of representing organic molecules (PDF 45-46).

blocks.text: Organic compounds ko zahir karne ke liye kai qism ke formule use hote hain.

items: Molecular formula: aik molecule mein har unsar ke atoms ki asal tadaad, maslan butane C4H10, ethanoic (acetic) acid C2H4O2, ethanol C2H6O. Yeh nahi batata ke atoms kaise jure hain, is liye mukhtalif compounds ka aik hi ho sakta hai: ethanol aur methoxymethane dono C2H6O hain.
Empirical formula: har unsar ke atoms ka sab se chhota poore adad ka tanasub, maslan butane (C4H10) ka C2H5 aur ethanoic acid (C2H4O2) ka CH2O.
Structural formula: atoms ki tadaad ke saath yeh bhi dikhata hai ke atoms kis tarteeb se jure hain.
Displayed (graphical) formula: atoms ke darmiyan har bond, bond ki qism aur functional groups ki jagah samet, dikhata hai.

Condensed (linear) formula: displayed formula aik lakeer mein; single bonds chhor diye jate, jab ke shaakhein, functional groups, multiple bonds aur dohraye CH2 groups dikhaye jate hain, maslan CH3(CH2)2CH3 (butane), CH3CH2OH (ethanol), CH3COOH (ethanoic acid).

Skeletal (bond-line) formula: carbon aur hydrogen ke nishan aur C-H bonds hata diye jate hain. Carbon-carbon bonds zaviye par milti lakeerein hain; har kona ya lakeer ka sira aik carbon hai jis par itne H hain ke chaar bond poore hon. Double aur triple bonds aur functional groups dikhaye jate hain, maslan ethanol aik chhoti lakeer hai jis ke aik sire par OH.

blocks.alt: Table jis mein butane aur ethanoic acid ki qataarein aur columns: molecular formula (C4H10; C2H4O2), empirical formula (C2H5; CH2O), displayed formula (har C-H, C-C, C=O, C-O aur O-H bond bana hua), condensed formula (CH3(CH2)2CH3; CH3COOH) aur skeletal formula (teen lakeeron ka zigzag; aik lakeer jo C=O aur OH wale carbon tak).
blocks.caption: Butane aur ethanoic acid ke formule likhne ke paanch tareeqe (is topic ke liye asal table).
blocks.long_description: Aik hi compound kai tareeqon se likha ja sakta hai. Molecular formula atoms ginta, empirical formula un ka saada tareen tanasub deta, displayed formula har bond dikhata, condensed formula aik lakeer mein aata, aur skeletal formula sirf carbon dhaancha aur functional groups dikhata hai.

blocks.explanation: 3,5-diethylheptane: saat carbon ki zanjeer jis ke C3 aur C5 par ethyl groups, CH3CH2CH(C2H5)CH2CH(C2H5)CH2CH3 (C11H24). 2-bromo-3,3-dichlorohexane: CH3CHBrCCl2CH2CH2CH3. 2-methylbutanal: CH3CH2CH(CH3)CHO. Skeletal shakal mein har aik zigzag hai jis par shaakhein aur Br, Cl ya CHO groups bane hon.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol aur methoxymethane ke condensed formule likhein. Kya yeh isomers hain?
blocks.explanation: CH3CH2OH aur CH3OCH3. Dono C2H6O hain lekin atoms mukhtalif tareeqe se jure hain (alcohol aur ether), is liye yeh alag compounds hain: functional group isomers.

blocks.prompt: Ethanoic acid, CH3COOH, ka skeletal formula bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Aik lakeer jo aise carbon par khatam ho jis par double bond wala O (=O) aur aik OH bana ho.

items: Molecular: atoms ki asal tadaad; empirical: saada tareen tanasub.
Structural: displayed, condensed aur skeletal formule.
Mukhtalif compounds ka molecular formula aik ho sakta hai (C2H6O).
